risk_note: Contract only, RV2 by path. adminResolveUnknownPayout gains the W10 voucher cross-check (BR-WDR-15 细则 and BR-TEXT-14 表 B as written back for D10-703): before anything is written, a paid resolution is refused with 20001 when the serial number given is another withdrawal's success bill line (resolve_order_id_other_order), when this withdrawal's latest success query answer or success bill line names a different serial (resolve_order_id_mismatch), or when its success bill line amount is not net_fen (resolve_amount_mismatch); a refusal writes only an audit record. A bill line without out_biz_no (offline transfer) is not another withdrawal's. A paid_at more than 5 minutes from a success query's paid time only warns. Without any query answer or bill line the checks do not apply. Only an /admin/v1/** description and the 20001 reason list change; data.reason is free text in the schema, so no oasdiff entry. The implementation is B2-09x.
